clanStatement.en: Peris Basweti was born of the Abagusii people, raised on the homestead in Kisii County, and is survived by a family that spans four generations. She is of the clan of her ancestors, and her name will be spoken at this homestead for generations to come.
clanStatement.sw: Alizaliwa miongoni mwa watu wa Abagusii, akalelewa katika shamba la Kisii County, na anaachwa na familia inayoenea vizazi vinne.
clanStatement.guz: Obariirwe o'Abagusii, atokerere o egesaku ye Kisii County, naanchirwe na abe baye bane na emabenga ine.
